name: Melanie
source:
Acting Head Maid of the Castle

Melanie left her family's ranch and came to work in the castle when she was ten years old.
Starting as one of Princess Marianne's personal attendants, her hardworking nature eventually led her to be considered for the position of Head Maid.
She did turn down the job, but still ended up saddled with its responsibilities anyways.

Melanie has managed to win over just about all of the eccentric personalities who reside in the castle with her kind and patient nature... and if there's anyone left in the castle who dislikes her, they've long since learned to keep their mouths shut for fear of catching the ire of certain individuals who are quite protective of her.

It's also recommended to stay far away from her when she first wakes up in the morning, for unrelated reasons.
